s: klI, (apaYcAtmakaM paYcAtmakaM kftaM, paYca + aBUtatadBAve cci kf + ktaH, tato naYsamAsaH । sUkzmaBUtaM । paYcIkftaBinnAkASAdipaYcaBUtaM । iti vedAntasAraH । (“paYcaprARamanobudDidaSendriyasamanvitaM । apaYcIkftaBUtotTaM sUkzmANgaM BogasADanaM” ॥ iti paYcadaSyAM .)
v: tri॰ apaYcAtmakaH paYcAtmakaH kftaH na॰ ta॰ । paYcAtmakatAmanAsAdite sUkzmaBUte, paYcIkAraprakArastu paYcIkaraRaSabde vakzyate “paYcaprARamanobudDidaSendriyasamanvitam apaYcIkftaBUtotTaM sUkzmANgaM BogasADanamiti” vedA॰ pa॰ ।
m: अ-पञ्ची-कृत n. (in Vedānta phil.) ‘not compounded of the five gross elements’, the five subtle elements.
अ-पञ्चम m. not a nasal, VPrāt.
अ-पञ्च-यज्ञ mfn. one who does not perform the 5 Mahā-yajñas (q.v.), L.
